# Brunet Brothers Construction

> Family-owned general contractor in Lake Worth, Palm Beach County, Florida, working all over South Florida since 2008. Their motto: "Masters of Consistency and Quality". Mostly bathroom and kitchen remodeling, also closets, home offices and living rooms, outdoor living, and new construction, residential and commercial. Four Florida certified licenses, all current and active (Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation): Certified General Contractor CGC1524915, Certified Plumbing Contractor CFC1430197, Certified Air Conditioning Contractor CAC1825088, Certified Roofing Contractor CCC1337876. Phone in English (561) 904-1465, in Spanish (561) 904-1893; email brunetbrothersconstruction@gmail.com. Free in-home estimates. The site is in English and in Spanish.

## Their work, in their own photos

- [Interior remodeling](https://www.brunetbrothersconstruction.com/#work): bathrooms (frameless glass showers, double vanities, freestanding tubs, a powder room), kitchens (white shaker and modern cabinets, islands, breakfast bars), a built-in closet, a home office desk, a stacked-stone TV wall with an electric fireplace. Every photo has a caption.
- [Exterior remodeling](https://www.brunetbrothersconstruction.com/#outside): one backyard, with an outdoor kitchen under a white pergola, a fire pit set in sand, and the pool deck.
- [New construction](https://www.brunetbrothersconstruction.com/#build): residential or commercial; "We work closely with clients, architects and engineers to finish every project on time and within budget." Wood trusses on block walls, and a hair salon.

## How a job runs (their FAQ)

- [Do you charge for estimates?](https://www.brunetbrothersconstruction.com/#process): No. They visit the home, take notes and measurements, then send a detailed proposal of the scope of work for the price quoted.
- [How long will my project take?](https://www.brunetbrothersconstruction.com/#process): It depends on the size and scope of the job; a construction schedule lists each step before work starts.
- [Do I need permits?](https://www.brunetbrothersconstruction.com/#process): Most remodels do. They get the permit, handle all the inspections and build to code.
- [Can I stay in my home during the work?](https://www.brunetbrothersconstruction.com/#process): For most upgrades, yes; a complete renovation may mean staying somewhere else for a while.
- [What is the payment process?](https://www.brunetbrothersconstruction.com/#process): Typically a 50% deposit to begin, payments at points set in the contract, and the final payment when the work is complete.
- [What is a change order?](https://www.brunetbrothersconstruction.com/#process): A written statement the client signs for extra work not in the contract, or for damage found along the way; its amount is due at completion.

## Clients

- [18 testimonials, word for word](https://www.brunetbrothersconstruction.com/#clients): kitchens and bathrooms; clients who left them their keys; a cleaning crew after the work; plumber, electrician, countertop and glass door coordinated by one person; repeat clients and referrals from neighbors and friends.
